about: How tools/pack.py builds Hearthstone 2014–2019 (docs/packs/format.md §13, packs/eras/README.md): one version per game version, oldest first; each is its base pack's rules files, texts and decks (versions/<id>/patch.json `base`) changed by its patch, plus its own scripts (versions/<id>/scripts/). The pictures, sounds, music and ui/ are every base pack's, shared.
